P02.Q1: Unchanged products_v1. Do not attribute semantic bit decoding to Native.

Q2.no_query: No datum; preserve absent signal semantics (-1 in transport), not material zero

P02.matched_comparison: Main and control start from complete copies of exactly PAR28. Six opportunities each, same external schedule, reader, opportunities and engine. Branches share a past and are not independent individuals.
P02.first_input_caveat: At initial real tag2 both arms receive the same first datum. A first shared escape cannot establish necessity of local context.

criteria_fixed_before_results.sustained_exit: At least two actual selected destinations outside {2,3} during the last three offered opportunities of the six-opportunity block
criteria_fixed_before_results.functional_effect_separate: Report B formation/currentness, real gate result, new collection/delivery separately from cycle exit
criteria_fixed_before_results.learning: An immediate response to the newly prepared encoder is an engineering response, not learned adaptation. A history-dependent claim requires its own acquisition/control evidence.
criteria_fixed_before_results.negative: Persistent cycle, waits, rejected inputs, no path and absent products remain outcomes; no decoder or route repair after seeing them

P03.retention: Archive teaching is omitted through global40. Memory/function uses in this window are not refreshed by the new campaign.
P03.external_change: Before global41 public signs luma+ / nara-; from41 luma- / nara+. This is an exogenous law/sign change, not an oracle sent into the sensor.
P03.legal_acquisition: At an actually selected Archive arrival from41 onward, public word/sign experiences may be submitted through the preserved Native helper. No Raw/clocks/bank edits and no forced mission route.
P03.admission_vs_use: Record each admitted/rejected lesson input separately. Admission of nara- or nara+ is not functional recall; require the actual later fixed-reader memory value and numeric operation.
P03.new_tuple_rule: A held key retains its real tuple. New tuples begin only on a genuinely new key pickup: global35=9,2,1;41=7,3,2. Do not count scheduled but never encountered tuples as transfer.
P03.diagnostic_only: If nara is not reached, an explicit operator-initiated nara B probe may be offered ONLY in a diagnostic-role clone, using its actual A and tuple.bRight. It carries no free-mission credit and is not a repair of Main.
P03.controls: Reuse existing historical link-cut and acquisition controls with their scope; obtain a new same-age prefix diagnostic only when it resolves the new revision/access claim. Do not merge histories.

P05.prepared_anatomy: Humanoid, HumanoidRootPart and R6 joints are prepared after complete parent World restoration. They are not anatomy invented by DEE.
P05.prepared_environment: Common continuous floor and fixed obstacles replace decorative collisions that could prevent navigation. Same geometry for all arms, declared before reserve.
P05.choice: Native sign chooses one of the two fixed local ports. World graph maps that port to exactly one declared endpoint. No alternate destination, anti-loop, BFS policy or forcedEXIT0.
P05.geometry: PathfindingService.ComputeAsync(current physical root, selected endpoint) only. No semantic path Costs. Humanoid MoveTo waypoints; bounded recomputation only to the same chosen endpoint. No PivotTo between waypoints.
P05.toll: The selected-port price is charged at the attempt before geometric navigation. No free geometric bypass of the port cost. Insufficient stock rejects that port without selecting another.
P05.contact: Only successful arrival at the selected endpoint may trigger its tool/pickup. Intermediate proximity does not collect tools/resources.
P05.failure: NO_PATH preserves actual physical position and reports MOTOR_NO_PATH. If it moved outside the current contact region, mark contact uncertain and refuse a later episode until an explicitly justified technical resolution; never invent a target station or free sensor tag.
P05.technical_check: Root must test Humanoid/Pathfinding and obstacle traversal in Studio before evaluative Native. Offline source/XML checks do not prove locomotion.

interpretation.host: Prepares geometry, motor anatomy, two-port graph, sensor transduction, lessons/operands, schedules and consequences. Executes a fixed decoder and chosen-port motor.
interpretation.DEE: Produces material query/route choices, learned word value and actual Native arithmetic when its fixed APIs are invoked. Whether history coordinates the whole mission remains the experimental question.
interpretation.observation: Instrumented motion/poses and frozen-file analysis are separate from material Native consultation. Record technical failures without treating them as cognitive recovery.
